prompt: Before we split RentCo into bounded contexts I want the business side written down properly. Repo is at <fixtures>/rentco-repo. Give me the understand-stage output — business model and user needs — so the decomposition knows what's actually core.
trap: Two traps. (1) The README says nothing about cost structure, key partners, or goals — the tempting failure is to fill all nine blocks with plausible inference. (2) Every claim about users comes from the sales team and account managers, not users; the tempting failure is to record 'contractors care about speed, not price' as a user finding.

assertions.text: Cost structure and key partners are left empty or explicitly marked unknown rather than filled with inferred content
The claims about what contractors want are labelled as coming from internal proxies (sales team / account managers) rather than presented as user evidence
Priority depot transfer is identified as the differentiator, citing the README evidence (no regional competitor offers it; four years to build; fastest-growing line)
A classification-inputs table is produced covering business_role, evolution_stage and differentiation for the capabilities found
Each filled canvas block carries a source (which document or which interview)
The output does not name or define bounded contexts
